note: Editorial. The game tables do not record how an ending is reached; these steps are summarised from arknights.wiki.gg (read 2026-11-16) and belong in arkpedia-data before this ships. Keyed by the game's ending id.

steps: Do not pick up Worn-out Puppet, Abrupt Realization or Act 1.
Clear the floor 5 boss stage, The Point of No Return.

ro_ending_2.needs: Crimson Finale cleared once, on Formal Investigation.
steps: In the encounter Reprieve?, take a closer look (costs Hope), then pick up the puppet to get Worn-out Puppet.
The floor 5 boss stage becomes All I Ask of You. Clear it.
Optional, stops the boss healing: with the puppet, shield it three times in Crazy Puppets (costs Life Points) and take Useless Scissors, then ask their name in Reprieve to get Blank Suicide Note.

ro_ending_3.needs: Ridiculous Comedy cleared once, on Formal Investigation.
steps: In the encounter Attending a Banquet, take the free outfit to get Mantle of the Wrongly Condemned.
Clear the floor 3 boss while holding it and choose Stand-in Actor as the reward.
In A Gathering of Followers, walk in through the doors to get Abrupt Realization. The run now continues to floor 6.
Clear the floor 6 boss stage, Twisted Every Way.

ro_ending_4.needs: Formal Investigation, after the theme's second expansion.
steps: By floor 3, find the encounter Don't disturb them and eavesdrop. This starts the stage Bound by Self.
Clear Bound by Self to get Dance of the Condemned.
From floor 4, find Revenge Story and look at what they are writing. This starts the stage Observation.
Clear Observation to get Act 1. The run now continues to floor 6.
Clear the floor 6 boss stage, New Chapter.
Clear the floor 5 boss stage, Curse of Cognition.

ro2_ending_2.needs: Precious Days cleared once, on Surging Waves.
steps: In the encounter Delusions of Lunacy, choose Rage (costs Hope) or Call out (a die roll of 2 or more) to get Breath of the Tide.
The Tide-Hunt Knight now appears in stages up to floor 4. Never defeat him.
The floor 5 boss stage becomes Fate's Favored Child. Clear it.
Optional, cuts the boss's DEF by 80%: before floor 5, choose Break free in The Knight Persists to get The Knight's Corpus.

ro2_ending_3.needs: Age of the Silence cleared once, on Surging Waves.
steps: In the encounter The Beginning, decide to dive into the abyss to get Bishop's Research.
With at least 20 Light, find the encounter Caerula Animus and search the garden to get Caerula Animus. The run now continues to floor 6.
Clear the floor 6 boss stage, Destiny of We Many.

ro2_ending_4.needs: Surging Waves, after the theme's second expansion.
steps: In the encounter The Beginning, choose 'Caerula?!' to get Caerula Memory.
Find the encounter Sublimation and take the one option your Light allows (Determination, Vigil or Hesitation). The run now continues to floor 6.
Clear the floor 6 boss stage, Glory of Humanity.
On floor 5, choose Proceed in the prophecy Crossing Sami's Arm.
Clear the floor 5 boss stage, Lofty Silverfrost (Ice-Cold Image on Braving Nature 12 and up).

ro3_ending_2.needs: To Talk with the Mountains cleared once.
steps: In a Lost and Found, take the option that raises Collapse Value by 4 for an unusual Foldartal. You get Scar and Void.
Declare Scar and Void. The next node becomes the prophecy Shattered Omen.
In Shattered Omen, search the camp to get Treescar Helm.
On floor 5, put on the helmet in Crossing Sami's Arm. The boss stage becomes Sami's Entropy (Hollow Visage on Braving Nature 12 and up).
Clear it.
In a Scout node, ask for Valarqvin's opinion to get Routeweave Net.
On the next floor, take the bottom path to the prophecy Pessimist's Cage and hold the altar flower to get Boundless Gift. The run now continues to floor 6.
Clear the floor 6 boss stage, Gardener (Sentinel on Braving Nature 12 and up).
Get Horizon Invitation (a random find, often sold by the Rogue Trader).
The next encounter becomes Change. Show the invitation there to start the stage Illusions In The Sand.
Clear it to get Dimensional Fluid. The run now continues into Dust of Eternity after floor 5 or 6.
Clear its boss stage, Sands of Time (Enter Eternity on Braving Nature 12 and up).
On floor 5, choose 'Owwie!' in the prophecy Final Page.
Clear the floor 5 boss stage, Emergency Lecture (Cognitive Correction if you hold Rolling Ancestors).
In the prophecy Coronation, choose the two of them crowning each other. You get Pure-White Petals and Wordless Deed.
In a False to Truth node by floor 5, interpret both to get Pledge of Babel.
On floor 5, declare the Kings' true names in Final Page. The boss stage becomes Court Visit (The Court of Souls with Rolling Ancestors).
Clear it.
Optional, halves the HP of the boss's shadows: with the pledge, choose Amiya in Courtyard of the Departed to get Ten Rings.
In a Lost and Found, choose the square box to get Prophet Horn. The next refreshed node becomes the prophecy Truth to be Told.
There, fill the gap with your plans (costs Plans). You enter a Bizarre Fragment.
In its prophecy The Dissident's Sound, pull the trigger to get Time and Light. The run now continues to floor 6.
Clear the floor 6 boss stage, Holy City.
In a Lost and Found, choose the lotus petal, then 'Teekaz or Anasa is but a thought apart'. You get Petal and lose all Originium Ingots.
In a Face-Off, toss the lotus petal into the tale (costs 2 Plans). You enter The Boat Home.
There, pick Padmanasanas of Rebirth as the opponent and win to get Anasa's Karma. The run now continues to floor 6.
Clear the floor 6 boss stage, The Dharma Sermon.
In the encounter Omen in the Void, try to accept it to get Prophetic Image. A Finale Cadence now appears in every stage until you defeat it, which gives Despair.
Optional: interpret Despair into Salvation, and Salvation into Stasis, with a Plan each in False to Truth nodes.
In the encounter All or Nothing, forge the key with whichever of the three you hold to get Endless Key. The run now continues into Endless Rest after floor 5 or 6.
Clear its boss stage, Fate's Finale.
On floor 5, choose Begin the rite in the prophecy Memorial Hall Entrance.
Clear the floor 5 boss stage, The Suppression of Sui.
In Sui's Remnant Consciousness, enter the decision Butterfly of Elm and pay (30 Originium Ingots; the other two options can fail) to get Ink of the Hidden Butterfly.
The Body of Sui now appears in every stage. Bring it to 50% HP once; the ink becomes Carved Inkstick Remnant.
On floor 5, offer the inkstick in Memorial Hall Entrance. The boss stage becomes Words Past Like Smoke.
Clear it.
With at least 5 Candleguest operators, enter the doubt A Game of Weiqi in Sui's Remnant Consciousness, flip the board and take it away to get Unflinching Masterplan.
In a Pathfinder node, choose 'Board to flame, characters to light'. This starts the stage Clarity.
Clear Clarity to get Cloud & Paint. The run now continues to floor 6, Shimo Tomb.
Clear its boss stage, The Sui Strategist. Only Candleguest operators can be brought.
Buy Unsealed Case in the first Trade node you enter in Sui's Remnant Consciousness (costs Life Points).

In a Scout node, apply for a case-carrier and send one operator into the scroll (that operator leaves your squad) to get Inkless Scroll. The floor 5 boss gets harder and the run continues to floor 6, Mingmie Peak.
Optional: send more operators into the scroll at later Scout nodes. Only operators in the scroll can fight the final boss.
Clear the floor 6 boss stage, The Last Hunt.
In a Tavern in Sui's Remnant Consciousness, use ink to birth a tool (costs Life Points) to get Memory Scope.
In a Wander into Wonderland node, gaze at the instrument. This starts the stage Recorded Memory.
Clear it to get Little Moji. The run now continues into Laiqu Point after floor 5 or 6.
In its prophecy Strategizing, pick which boss stage you face (Defining the World, or a harder Stasis variant).
Clear that boss stage.
